text:
zoe: low-stakes question for the room: if our office plants had LinkedIn bios, what would they say? also drop any stealth plant-care hacks. go! :seedling:
andre: 'Monstera: Senior Air-Purifying Specialist, 3 years of silent productivity, seeks bright indirect light and compliments.'
maria: 'Pothos: People-pleaser. Thrives on neglect and gossip. Will cascade into your heart.' :heart:
diego: Hack: rotate plants on windowsill weekly so no one gets stage-fright. also mist once when you remember. :sun_with_face:
sunita: 'Snake Plant: On-call at all hours. Low maintenance, high stoicism.' :snake:
kate: Secret hack: put coffee grounds (cool & diluted) into potting soil for a slow caffeine boost. small amounts only tho. :coffee:
andre: Also, label plants with tiny index cards for names and a funny pronoun. morale boost. :label:
zoe: Vote time: drop one emoji for your favorite plant-bio above (or propose a new bio).
maria: :heart: (Pothos forever)
diego: :sun_with_face: (rotate windowsill)
sunita: :snake: (snake plant vibes)
kate: :coffee: (guilty grounds)
andre: :seedling: (I like the Monstera LinkedIn)
ops-bot: Friendly reminder from Facilities: if you take a plant home, please update the #office-ops board and tag @facilities. Also, watering rota in the fridge is real. :robot_face:
zoe: thanks ops-bot. Proposal: anyone want to bring in a 'rescue plant' next week and we can start a tiny adopt-a-plant shelf? low-effort, makes the space cozier.
maria: I can bring one! tiny succulents for beginners.
sunita: I'll sponsor a snake plant (tenacity donation).
kate: If we get plush stickers of the LinkedIn bios, I'm ordering 10. :tada:
zoe: Beautiful. I'll make a sticky sign-up on Monday. Thanks all for the plant wisdom and the hacks  this was wholesome.
